messages.content:
All three requested feature groups—**Expandable 18+ Subreddit & Niche Directory**, **Smarter 18+ Discovery & Vault Playback**, and **Quick Skip & Speed Control**—have been added and verified with unit tests. Everything is saved.

---

### 1. 📚 Expandable 18+ Subreddit & Niche Directory
* **Built-In Categorized 18+ Browser ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L403-L421), [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L142-L173)):**
  * Added [`ADULT_DIRECTORY_CATALOG`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L142-L173) in the **Sources** tab (`#adultDirectorySection`), organized into **🔥 Popular 18+ Subreddits**, **🎬 RedGIFs HD & Loop Niches**, and **📺 Full-Length 18+ Tube & Archive**.
  * Added [`toggleAdultDirectory`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1314-L1330), [`renderAdultDirectory`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1332-L1379), [`toggleDirectorySource`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1250-L1277), and [`enableAllDirectorySources`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1279-L1312) so you can expand/collapse the directory, toggle individual subreddits or niches on/off with 1 tap (`+ Enable` / `✓ Active`), enable all directory sources at once, or tap **`▶ Pull`** to immediately load a clip from that niche into the Player.

---

### 2. 🔥 Smarter 18+ Discovery & Vault Playback
* **🏷️ Interactive Video Tags & "🔥 More Like This" ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L162-L169), [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L3151-L3231)):**
  * Added [`extractSmartVideoTags`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L3151-L3197), [`buildMoreLikeThisQuery`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L3199-L3218), and [`pullMoreLikeThis`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L3220-L3231).
  * Displays clickable `#tag` chips (`#videoTagsBar`) below the active video title and a **🔥 More Like This** button (`#moreLikeThisBtn` on the Player and `#reelsMoreLikeBtn` in Fullscreen Reels HUD) to immediately pull matching clips.
* **🎲 "Shuffle My Vault" & Vault Favorites `❤️` ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L595-L615), [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1034-L1112)):**
  * Added 1-tap `❤️` Favorites on both the Player (`#favoriteCurrentBtn`, [`toggleCurrentVideoFavorite`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1055-L1071)) and Vault cards ([`toggleVaultFavorite`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1034-L1053)), plus **`❤️ Favorites Only`** and **`🔞❤️ 18+ Favorites`** filter options in `#vaultFilterSelect`.
  * Added **🎲 Shuffle Vault in Player** (`#shuffleVaultBtn`) and **📱 Swipe Vault in Reels** (`#reelsVaultPlayBtn`) powered by [`shuffleVaultToPlayer`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1073-L1112) to load your saved Vault videos directly into the Player or Fullscreen Reels mode.

---

### 3. ⏩ Quick Skip (`-10s` / `+15s` / `+30s`) & Speed Control (`0.5x` – `2x`)
* **1-Tap Scrubbing & Variable Speed ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L174-L194), [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1751-L1800)):**
  * Added `#quickSkipBar` with **`⏪ -10s`** (`#skipBack10Btn`), **`+15s ⏩`** (`#skipFwd15Btn`), **`+30s ⏭`** (`#skipFwd30Btn`), and **`+15s`** in Fullscreen Reels (`#reelsSkip15Btn`), powered by [`skipVideoTime`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1751-L1781) (which also updates your saved resume timestamp).
  * Added `#playbackSpeedSelect` (`0.5x Slow`, `0.75x`, `1x`, `1.25x`, `1.5x Fast`, `2x Turbo`) powered by [`setPlaybackSpeed`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1783-L1800), persisting across videos.

---

### 🧪 Verification
* Added unit tests in [tests/adult-suite.test.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/adult-suite.test.js#L543-L735) covering the Expandable 18+ Directory, Smart Tags & More Like This, Vault Favorites & Shuffle, and Quick Skip & Playback Speed — **all 98 tests across 36 suites pass**.
